summary.tldr: Requires railway companies to give passenger rail service priority over freight when there is a conflict, and allows penalties for breaking the rule.
what_it_does: Requires railway companies to give passenger rail service priority over freight when there is a conflict on a railway line.
Allows a breach of this rule to be handled as a violation under the Canada Transportation Act, with a maximum penalty of $250,000 for each violation.
Lets the Minister delegate related violation powers, duties, or functions to the Canadian Transportation Agency.
summary.background: It amends the Canada Transportation Act.
